name: Shop & Product Browse
description: Verifies the shop page loads with product cards, filtering works, product detail page renders with gallery and add-to-cart, and search functionality works.

planSteps.description: Click the 'Shop' link in the navigation bar
Verify the collection page loads with a grid of product cards showing images, names, and prices
Click on a filter button such as 'Dresses' in the category filter bar
Verify the product grid updates to show filtered results
Click on the first product card in the grid
Verify the product detail page loads with a product image gallery on the left, product name, price, size selector, and an 'Add to Cart' or 'Add to Collection' button
Click the search icon in the navigation bar
Type 'dress' into the search input field
Verify search results appear showing products matching the search term
